rules.description: Every public SSL page must include the canonical global navigation.
Every public page must be reachable from the global nav, local nav, footer, or site map.
All future public pages inherit the canonical SSL navigation pattern by default.
Local navigation should only include pages belonging to the current project or repo.
Every public page must have a page schema card.
Every public page must be listed in the public site map.
The active navigation item must use aria-current="page".
Navigation must be fully usable by keyboard only.
Every page must include a skip link to main content.
